name: Hewitt Christmas Tree Lighting at Warren Park
address: 450 S Old Temple Rd, Hewitt, TX 76643
when_note: It runs on a Thursday evening.
paras: The Greater Hewitt Chamber of Commerce lights the city Christmas tree at Warren Park on a Thursday evening, presented by Christ Our Refuge Lutheran Church. Midway ISD carolers sing while vendors and food trucks set up around the park, and Santa makes an appearance.
The chamber expects more than 1,500 people to come and go through the evening. Parking is free, and Toys for Tots collects new, unwrapped toys at the event.
tip: Bring a new, unwrapped toy for the Toys for Tots collection and come early for the vendors before the lighting.
